title: A groom's friends made a surprise AI film of his love story for his wedding
title_candidates: A groom's friends made a surprise AI film of his love story for his wedding
How AI turned a real couple's love story into a film across five different eras
None of this wedding film is real, and the groom had no idea it was coming
What a film studio would charge for, a few friends made with AI at a wedding
The AI wedding video that looks like a Hollywood film from five different eras
caption:
A few friends learned AI video tools and made a surprise wedding film showing the couple's love story across different eras of history.

The video ends exactly where they actually met. No film crew, no director, no budget. Just AI tools and people who cared enough to make something real.

This is what AI video looks like when regular people use it for something that matters.
